body.objective: Prevent resident agents from receiving a false empty-queue result because user-facing live readiness and status commands silently evaluate leases at `now=unbounded` when `--now` is omitted.
body.stop_condition: Define two explicit time modes and make them impossible to confuse. For the user-facing `s-f` launcher, live coordination commands including `work ready`, `work pull`, `work show`, `overview`, `agent status`, `await` and lease mutation must, when `--now` is omitted, inject the canonical UTC value produced by `s-f now`, print that resolved snapshot, and apply bounded-lease expiry normally. Deterministic core/replay callers must continue to require an explicit timestamp, or opt into a visibly named `--timeless`/`--now-unbounded` mode whose output is labeled NON_LIVE_REPLAY and which is refused for mutation. Do not make the native `sfc` backend depend on the host clock. Ensure that the launcher-generated timestamp is passed once through the normalized RFC3339 comparator and recorded on every mutation. Add both-backend and launcher fixtures for a lease that expired five minutes ago: bare interactive `s-f work ready --stream S` must return the item READY, bare interactive overview must label the lease EXPIRED, explicit historical `--now` must reproduce the earlier LIVE state, explicit timeless replay must preserve the old fold with a prominent non-live label, and no mutating command may create or renew an unbounded lease. Cover agent-aware current-assignment recovery and prove byte stability for fixed explicit timestamps.
body.forbid: no hidden host-clock lookup inside deterministic sfc; no silent change to explicit `--now`; no timeless mutation; no lexical timestamp comparison; no treating a future expiry as a future-dated event; no auto-release or lifecycle rewrite; no physics-specific stream exception; no output that merely says zero ready without stating the resolved time mode.
notes: Live reproduction 2026-07-21 17:09 Europe/Berlin: `nonlinear-1` ran bare `s-f work ready --stream nonlinear`, received `0 ready ... at now=unbounded`, and stopped. Its exclusive lease actually expired at 2026-07-21T14:56:59Z. At explicit `--now 2026-07-21T15:07:28Z`, the same command correctly returned `nonlinear-branch-repair-residual-orbit-obstruction-freeze-v2` READY. The false timeless default left a Phase-1 closure item idle until coordinator inspection.

The Black Hole resident likewise reported an empty queue while holding an unstarted Paper 14 freeze and using the resident polling convention without an explicit current snapshot. Existing agent-aware lease recovery and stale-inbox requests are complementary; neither fixes the time-mode ambiguity.

The desired split preserves Science Forge's reproducibility principle: explicit-time and explicitly timeless core evaluations stay deterministic. Only the interactive launcher resolves omitted time, exactly as `s-f now` already provides canonical UTC for safe commands.
